_comment: Defender for Cloud plan recommendations per workload. Standard tier is paid. Apply with: az security pricing create -n <plan> --tier Standard. Run for each plan.

recommendations.value: OS-level threat detection, JIT VM access, file integrity monitoring, regulatory compliance reports.
Detect anomalous traffic, web shell uploads, brute-force on login pages.
Anomalous access detection, malware scanning (paid extra), sensitive data scanning.
Vulnerability assessment, anomalous queries, SQL injection detection.
Detect malicious or anomalous Resource Manager operations (cleanup roles, disabled logging).
Anomalous queries on Postgres / MySQL / MariaDB Flexible Servers.
Anomalous query / access detection on Cosmos DB.
